posts.title: Lessons from writing my dissertation
posts.description: I have just wrapped up my third year dissertation, a harrowing experience that deeply affirmed my desire to pursue a PhD. In an effort to milk some value out of the numerous mistakes I made along the way, I have collated below what I wish I knew before I started. Start writing within the first month of your project.
